key_impacts: Storm surge flooding in New York City exceeded 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
About 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak across the affected region.
Hess Port Reading and Phillips 66 Bayway refineries shut, removing 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD operating capacity.
Gas stations in New Jersey were unable to operate due to power outages.
Three healthcare facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients because of outages.
evidence_snippets: On Oct 29, Sandy’s surge caused NYC flooding exceeding the 100-year floodplain by 53% citywide.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
As of Nov 6, 2012, Hess Port Reading and Bayway Phillips 66 refineries were shut down.
